prompt: Two objects. Name the event, and the first action the governing procedure requires.
plot_description: Relative position of a secondary about a primary. The loop drifts slowly outward for several revolutions, then snaps back to its original size, then drifts out again.
accepted_classifications: station keeping in the relative frame
accepted_first_actions: establish the relative motion in the hill frame
determine whether relative motion is bounded
check whether the relative motion is bounded
expert_cue: The snap-back is the cue. Natural dynamics let the loop grow; only control returns it. That is control authority made visible.
